definition.affected: more than one road tile touches the destination footprint, so the (encoded) observation does not mark which one is the carpark entry
definition.resolvable_by_leaf_rule: affected, but exactly one touching road tile is a dead end (degree 1) and it is the true entry (a rule a policy could learn from the observation)
definition.unresolvable_by_leaf_rule: affected and the leaf rule does not single out the true entry
definition.where_the_information_is: the raw native PolicyObservation JSON carries contentType 'Carpark' on the carpark tiles; python/mini_motorways_env.py::_CONTENT_TYPE_ORDINAL has only None/House/Destination, so Carpark (like Tree) is encoded as 0 by .get(..., 0)

verdict: The ambiguity exists in the live native observations as encoded for the policy. It is an ENCODING omission, not missing game information: the native observation JSON identifies carpark tiles, the python encoder discards that. Whether the encoded observation still suffices depends on the leaf rule (see categories).
